# Step 7 -- Phase 3: GMU Fusion (Weather x Satellite)

Gated Multimodal Unit (GMU) fusing **128-dim weather embeddings** (BiLSTM, Step 4) with **64-dim satellite embeddings** (SentinelEncoder, Step 6). Fine-tuned on 28 multimodal state-years (2021-2022; AZ 2022 excluded per B8).

**Architecture**

`
WeatherInput (1, 9) -----> BiLSTM.encode() -----> e_w (128-dim)
                                                         |
SatelliteInput (12,224,224) -> CNN.encode() -> e_s (64-dim)
                                                         |
                    proj_w(e_w) -> h_w (128-dim)
                    proj_s(e_s) -> h_s (128-dim)
                    z = sigmoid(W_z * [e_w; e_s])   <- modality gate
                    h = z * h_w + (1-z) * h_s       <- gated fusion
                    head(h) --> y_hat (scalar)
`

**Training strategy**
- Phase A: Freeze both encoders -- only GMU gate + head update (60 epochs, LR=5e-4)
- Phase B: Unfreeze all -- end-to-end fine-tuning (30 epochs, LR=1e-5)

**Sub-steps**
- **7.1** Load pre-trained encoders; build MultimodalDataset
- **7.2** GMUFusionModel definition with gated fusion
- **7.3** Phase A: frozen-encoder warm-start training
- **7.4** Phase B: end-to-end fine-tuning + LOSO 2022 evaluation
- **7.5** Bias audit: sliced RMSE/bias by state, year, yield quintile
- **7.6** Save GMU checkpoint + project summary
